Scale: ~1.2M searchable artifacts for initial POC; long-term target 8-12M docs (attachments + ticket text + product guides)

Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory; retention controls for PII; audit logging for queries and model outputs required for 180 days
Fallback strategy: require automatic fallback to smaller CPU-friendly ranker or cached responses under Dedicated capacity pressure — asked about Redwood's smart routing and model variant policies
Integration: they use our SDKs but want a GRPC option for low-latency agent UI; asked about streaming responses and function-calling for contextual actions
POC success metrics: 1) Top-5 precision >= 0.88, 2) Avg end-to-end latency <120ms on representative traffic, 3) ~30% reduction in live agent escalations in test environment
